Biography
Aakash Tyagi has a PhD in Computer Engineering in the field of Semiconductor Yield Modeling and Design for Manufacturability. He has over two decades of industry experience at Intel Corporation in end-to-end CPU development including front-end logic design, functional verification, physical design, circuit design, and silicon debug and validation. Since 2014, he has been with Texas A&M University Department of Computer Science and Engineering as a Professor of Practice where he teaches courses in Computer Organization, Systems Programming, and Software Testing and leads research and workforce development activities in hardware verification.
